class.name: NetwEntity
class.brief_description: The identity of one networked node, player or server-owned.
class.description:
One networked entity is one root node holding one [NetwEntity]. Nodes under the root read it to learn who the entity is, who controls it, and when it spawns and despawns. [codeblock] NetwEntity.of(node) # walks up to the entity, null when there is none Netw.configure_entity(self) # gets or creates it on a root, in _init NetwEntity.ensure(root) # gets or creates it on this exact node [/codeblock] [member controller] is settled before the node enters the tree, so [method Node.is_multiplayer_authority] is already correct in [method Node._enter_tree] and [method Node._ready] on every peer. [codeblock] var entity := NetwEntity.of(hit_node) if entity and entity.is_player: eliminate(entity.peer_id) [/codeblock]
[b]Declaring an entity[/b] A root declares itself in [code]_init[/code]. A child marks its own spawn properties in its [code]_init[/code] and connects to the entity in [method Node._ready], once it has a parent to walk up to. [codeblock] # on the root func _init() -> void: var entity := Netw.configure_entity(self) entity.initial_controller = NetwEntity.INITIAL_REPRESENTED_PEER entity.spawned.connect(_on_spawned) Netw.configure_property(self, &"position").on_spawn()
# on a child func _init() -> void: Netw.configure_property(self, &"health").on_spawn()
func _ready() -> void: NetwEntity.of(self).despawning.connect(_on_despawning) [/codeblock] A node placed in a scene by hand sets its own [member entity_id]. A spawned copy receives it with the spawn. [codeblock] func _init() -> void: Netw.configure_entity(self).entity_id = &"ball" [/codeblock]
[b]Control[/b] [member controller] is the peer that steers the entity, and [code]0[/code] means the server. The root and every node under it take the controller as their multiplayer authority, as if [method Node.set_multiplayer_authority] was called on each. [method follow_session] keeps a subtree with the server, which is where a [MultiplayerSynchronizer] the server writes belongs. [codeblock] func _init() -> void: Netw.configure_entity(self).follow_session(^"ServerSync")
func _physics_process(_delta: float) -> void: if entity.is_controlled_locally: steer() [/codeblock] The server moves control by writing [member controller]. A client asks with [method claim_authority] and hands it on with [method release_authority]. Both return a [NetwPromise] that resolves once the server's decision reaches this peer. [codeblocks] [gdscript] func grab() -> void: entity.claim_authority(NetwEntity.HOLD_EXCLUSIVE) \ .then(func(_held: NetwEntity) -> void: attach_to_hand()) \ .catch_error(func(_code: Error, _detail: String) -> void: drop())
func throw() -> void: entity.release_authority() [/gdscript] [csharp] private void Grab() { entity.ClaimAuthority(NetwEntity.HoldEnum.Exclusive) .Then(Callable.From((NetwEntity held) => AttachToHand())) .CatchError(Callable.From((Error code, string detail) => Drop())); }
private void Throw() { entity.ReleaseAuthority(); } [/csharp] [/codeblocks] [member transfer] decides whether a peer may ask, and the [enum Hold] of the current controller decides whether the server refuses. Under [constant TRANSFER_IMMEDIATE] the asking peer runs the entity before the decision arrives. [member NetwSimulationHandle.claim_on_contact] and [member NetwSimulationHandle.release_on_rest] let a body take control of what it touches and hand it back once it rests.
[b]Letting the controller spawn and despawn[/b] Only the server spawns, moves and despawns an entity by default. When [member lifecycle] is [constant LIFECYCLE_CONTROLLER] the [member controller] may too, and the change shows on its screen at once. The server can refuse it in [signal lifecycle_requested], and the change is then undone on the controller. [codeblock] func _init() -> void: Netw.configure_entity(self).lifecycle = NetwEntity.LIFECYCLE_CONTROLLER [/codeblock]
[b]Simulation[/b] [member simulation] says how the entity's body runs on each peer, [member prediction] how a controller runs it ahead, and [member interpolation] how it is drawn. [codeblock] func _init() -> void: var entity := Netw.configure_entity(self) entity.simulation.replicas = NetwSimulationHandle.REPLICAS_ACTIVE entity.prediction.archetype = NetwPredict.ARCHETYPE_SOLVER_BODY [/codeblock]

method.name: claim_authority
method.description: Asks the server to make this peer the [member controller] with [param hold]. The returned [NetwPromise] resolves with this entity once the decision reaches this peer. [codeblock lang=text] Error ┠╴ERR_UNAUTHORIZED another peer's hold or control_requested refused it ┠╴ERR_UNAVAILABLE transfer does not allow a claim ┖╴ERR_TIMEOUT no decision arrived within one second [/codeblock] Under [constant TRANSFER_IMMEDIATE] this peer runs the entity before the decision, and a refusal writes back the controller's latest values. [codeblock] entity.claim_authority(NetwEntity.HOLD_YIELDABLE) \ .then(func(_held: NetwEntity) -> void: pick_up()) \ .catch_error(func(_code: Error, _detail: String) -> void: shrug()) [/codeblock] [b]Player request.[/b]

method.name: despawn
method.description:
Frees [member owner] after emitting [signal despawning] and saving its [member persistence]. Entities under it despawn too, unless their [member on_parent_despawn] is [constant PARENT_DESPAWN_DETACH]. [codeblock] entity.despawn()
var opts := NetwDespawnOpts.create(&"killed") opts.flush_save = false entity.despawn(opts) [/codeblock] The server may call it, and so may the [member controller] of a [constant LIFECYCLE_CONTROLLER] entity.

method.name: ensure
method.description: Gets or creates the record on [param root] itself, without walking up to a parent entity.

method.name: follow_session
method.description: Keeps the node at [param path], and every node under it, with the server as its multiplayer authority whoever the [member controller] is. [param path] is relative to the entity root. Call it in [code]_init[/code] so every peer applies the same rule.

method.name: of
method.description: The [NetwEntity] of [param node]'s entity root, walking up the parents, or [code]null[/code] when [param node] is under no entity.

method.name: release_authority
method.description: Hands control of this entity to [param successor], or to the server when it is [code]0[/code]. The returned [NetwPromise] resolves with this entity once the decision reaches this peer. The request carries this peer's latest [method NetwPropertyConfig.broadcast] values, and [param successor] starts from them. Values larger than 1024 bytes are not sent, and [param successor] starts from its own copy. [codeblock lang=text] Error ┠╴ERR_UNAUTHORIZED this peer neither controls the entity nor is claiming it ┖╴ERR_UNAVAILABLE successor holds no copy of the entity [/codeblock] [b]Player request.[/b]

method.name: spawn_under

members.member: The peer whose [NetwAction] spawned this entity, or [code]0[/code].
The tick of the [NetwAction] that spawned this entity, or [code]-1[/code] when no action spawned it.
The [NetwDespawnOpts] of the despawn in progress, readable during [signal despawning], or [code]null[/code].
Whether a peer or the server controls this entity. See [enum ControlKind].

The peer that steers this entity, [code]0[/code] for the server. Written before the entity reaches [constant STAGE_ARMED], it sets the starting controller in place of [member initial_controller]. Written on the server after that, it moves control on every peer and resets [member hold] to [constant HOLD_NONE]. A client asks with [method claim_authority]. [codeblock] entity.controller = peer_id # hand it to a peer entity.controller = 0 # take it back to the server [/codeblock]
The player [member controller] names, or [code]null[/code]. It can differ from [member player], since a player can steer a server-owned entity.

The name that identifies this entity on every peer, and in saves and logs. A node placed in a scene sets it in [method Object._init], since an entity without one stays inactive. [method Netw.spawn_player] sets it to the player's [member NetwPlayer.username], so a game giving one player several bodies sets a distinct id on each.
How strongly [member controller] holds this entity. Control the server gives out by itself holds [constant HOLD_NONE].
The entity's [NetwInterestHandle]. Never [code]null[/code], and what is declared on it survives leaving and re-entering the tree.
The entity's [NetwDisplayHandle], which configures how the entity is drawn. A single value is smoothed with [NetwInterpolate].
[code]true[/code] while a [method claim_authority] from this peer is waiting for its decision.
[code]true[/code] when this peer controls the entity, or is claiming a [constant TRANSFER_IMMEDIATE] entity.

[code]true[/code] when this entity is a multiplayer scene, which [member scene] returns for it and every entity under it. Declared with [method Netw.configure_multiplayer_scene] in [code]_init[/code]. [codeblock] func _init() -> void: Netw.configure_multiplayer_scene(self).labeled(&"Arena") [/codeblock]
[code]true[/code] when this entity represents a player, meaning [member peer_id] is not [code]0[/code].
Whether this peer is the server, which decides [member controller] and every [method claim_authority]. Also [code]true[/code] offline.

[code]true[/code] when this entity is a hidden, inactive copy kept only to spawn others from with [method spawn_under]. A root placed inside another scene in the editor with no [member entity_id] is already a template. To make one in code, set this before it enters the tree, from outside its own script. [codeblock] var spawner := preload("res://mob.tscn").instantiate() NetwEntity.ensure(spawner).is_template = true add_child(spawner) [/codeblock] The mark cannot be undone.

Who may spawn, move and despawn this entity. Set it in [code]_init[/code] beside [member transfer]. A refused call pushes an error and returns its failure value. [method Node.reparent] cannot be refused, so it warns and the move stays on this peer. During a prediction replay these calls return [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_BUSY] with no error, so a predicted step spawns only on a fresh tick. [codeblock] func _init() -> void: var entity := Netw.configure_entity(self) entity.lifecycle = NetwEntity.LIFECYCLE_CONTROLLER [/codeblock]
The root's [member Node.multiplayer], or [code]null[/code] before the entity spawns.
What happens to the entity when its [member controller] disconnects. A player's own body still despawns with its [member peer_id].
The root [Node] that holds this entity, or [code]null[/code] once it is freed.
Whether this entity is a player or server-owned. See [enum Ownership].
The peer this entity represents, or [code]0[/code] for a server-owned entity such as an NPC or prop. A player's entity is listed in [member NetwPlayer.bodies] and despawns when that peer disconnects.
The entity's saved row, built from its [NetwPersistenceConfig] and the [method NetwPropertyConfig.persisted] properties under it.
The player [member peer_id] represents, or [code]null[/code] for a server-owned entity.
The entity's [NetwPredictionHandle], holding its prediction settings and counters. Never [code]null[/code]. How the entity steps is on [member simulation].
The [RID] that [NetwMultiplayer] methods take for this entity. [codeblock] var state := Netw.of(self).entity_get_state(entity.rid) [/codeblock]
The number that addresses this entity in packets, or [code]0[/code] when it has none. [method NetwMultiplayer.entity_from_route] maps it back to the entity.

The scene this entity belongs to, which is itself when [member is_multiplayer_scene] is set and otherwise the nearest scene above it. Never [code]null[/code], so read [member NetwSceneHandle.is_declared] to know whether one was found. Two entities in the same scene return the same handle. [codeblock] if NetwEntity.of(shooter).scene == NetwEntity.of(target).scene: apply_damage() [/codeblock]
How this entity's body runs on each peer, and which other entities it runs here. Never [code]null[/code].
Where the entity is in its lifecycle.
The entity's [NetwTimeline] of state and input snapshots, or [code]null[/code]. Moving the entity drops the snapshots taken before the move, so a rewind starts after it.
Whether peers may ask for control with [method claim_authority]. Set it in the root's [code]_init[/code] beside [member initial_controller].

signal.name: control_changed
signal.description: Emitted once on each peer when [member controller] changes, after node authority has moved.

signal.name: control_requested
signal.description: Emitted on the server when a peer calls [method claim_authority]. Calling [method NetwControlRequest.deny] on [param request] refuses it, whatever the listener order. Not emitted when a [member hold] already refuses the request.

signal.name: despawned
signal.description: Emitted once the entity has been freed, by [method despawn] or by freeing [member owner] directly. [member owner] may already be [code]null[/code], so cleanup that needs the node belongs in [signal despawning].

signal.name: despawning
signal.description: Emitted right before [method despawn] frees the entity, with its [param reason], while [member owner] can still be read. [member active_despawn_opts] is set during it. Freeing the owner directly does not emit it.

signal.name: hidden
signal.description: Emitted on a client that loses its copy of the entity without the entity being despawned, such as a hide under [constant NetwMultiplayer.LEAVE_POLICY_HIDE]. The entity may come back later with the same [member rid]. Neither [signal despawning] nor [signal despawned] is emitted, so anything tied to a body that may return connects here.

signal.name: interest_enter
signal.description: Emitted when [param peer_id] starts seeing this entity. On a client [param peer_id] is the local peer. [signal NetwInterestLayer.entity_visible] also names the layer.

signal.name: interest_exit
signal.description: Emitted when [param peer_id] stops seeing this entity.

signal.name: lifecycle_refused
signal.description: Emitted on the peer whose spawn, despawn or move of this entity the server refused, before the change is undone. [member NetwLifecycleRequest.reason] is what the server passed to [method NetwLifecycleRequest.deny], or empty when the server refused for another reason.

signal.name: lifecycle_requested
observer_entered
signal.description: Emitted when [param peer_id] starts seeing this entity through [param layer_id].

signal.name: observer_left
signal.description: Emitted when [param peer_id] stops seeing this entity through [param layer_id].

signal.name: reparented
signal.description: Emitted once after the entity moves to a new parent, by [method Node.reparent], [method Netw.reparent], or [method Node.remove_child] followed by [method Node.add_child]. Read the new parent from [member owner]. [code]_exit_tree[/code] also runs during a move, so teardown that must happen once belongs in [signal despawning] or [signal hidden]. [codeblock] NetwEntity.of(self).reparented.connect(reset_smoothing) [/codeblock]

signal.name: spawned
signal.description: Emitted once after the owner's [method Node._ready] completes.

signal.name: spawning
signal.description: Emitted once after identity, authority and spawn properties are applied. The owner is in the tree, but [method Node._ready] may still be running.

signal.name: view_activated
signal.description: Emitted when this entity's player becomes the view shown on this peer. With nothing connected, [HostSceneView] makes the first camera current, so connect it to use your own camera.

constants.constant: A player. [member peer_id] is not [code]0[/code].
A server-owned entity such as an NPC or world object. [member peer_id] is [code]0[/code].
A peer controls the entity. [member controller] is not [code]0[/code].
The server controls the entity. [member controller] is [code]0[/code].
The server controls the entity at spawn.
The peer in [member peer_id] controls the entity at spawn.
Every [method claim_authority] is refused.
Peers may ask the server for control.

Like [constant TRANSFER_REQUESTABLE], and the asking peer runs the entity before the decision arrives. A refusal puts back the controller's latest values. Not available on an entity with a [method NetwPropertyConfig.state] property, prediction, or a [MultiplayerSynchronizer].
Keeps no other peer out.
Another peer's [constant HOLD_EXCLUSIVE] claim takes the entity. Another peer's [constant HOLD_YIELDABLE] claim is refused.
Every other peer's claim is refused. Only the server writing [member controller] moves the entity.
The server takes control when the controller disconnects.
The entity despawns when its controller disconnects.
The entity despawns with the entity above it.
The entity moves up to its despawning parent's own parent, keeping where it stands. A held item drops where its holder stood.
Only the server spawns, moves and despawns the entity. Other peers are refused with [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_UNAUTHORIZED].

The [member controller] may also spawn, move and despawn the entity, and a peer that spawns one becomes its controller. Other peers are refused with [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_UNAUTHORIZED]. A predicted entity, a player's body, and an entity replicated by a [MultiplayerSynchronizer] or [MultiplayerSpawner] allow only the server, and refuse other peers with [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_UNAVAILABLE].
No identity yet, and nothing is sent for it. A node created in code starts here.
A template. See [member is_template].
Identity is set and the node has not entered the tree yet.
In the tree with a [member route].
Being despawned. See [member active_despawn_opts].
Inactive but still available to rewind, waiting to be freed.
The owner is gone.
